prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1043; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical care.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the collision.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, claim files, adjuster notes, and any electronic data or communications. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
